canon: Single colour canon for every tower and its Blender material set. A Meshy reference defines form, zone layout, details and wear, not colour; a colour difference from a reference is not a defect.

edge_light.use: worn light edges and chamfer highlights

grime.use: dust and wear on olive and steel

brass.use: brass bands, axle bushings, muzzle rims and barrel clamps; taken from the Gatling brass_band material (2026-11-07)

zones_note: Blender material (zone) name -> role. Base Color = role hex converted to linear; teal_indicator also uses the teal hex as Emission Color, with the strength from 'emission_strength' (calibrated so the lens renders as the teal hex, +-0.02, game camera, standard view transform).
